description: This file contains a static class 'StringEncodedWriteVector' that provides methods to encode, decode, and manipulate a bitvector representing replica states within a string. The methods include retrieving a specific bit ('GetBit') and flipping a bit ('FlipBit') for a representation of replicas in an Orleans Event Sourcing context.

classes.name: StringEncodedWriteVector
classes.description: A static class that manages bitvector encoding of replica states within a string, supporting operations like get and flip bits.

methods.name: GetBit
methods.description: Retrieves the bit (presence or absence) of a specified replica in the write vector string.

methods.name: FlipBit
methods.description: Toggles the specified replica's bit in the write vector string, updating it accordingly and returning the new bit state.
